preconditions.expression: n == len(s) and isinstance(n, int) and isinstance(s, str) and n >= 1 and n <= 100 and s.islower()
preconditions.description: Input consists of a positive integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100) and a lowercase string s of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' or c == '*' for c in stdout) and len(stdout) == len(s) and all(stdout[i] == '*' if (i > 0 and i < len(stdout) - 1 and stdout[i] == '*' and stdout[i-1] == '*' and stdout[i+1] == '*') else True for i in range(len(stdout)))
postconditions.description: Output is a string of the same length as input, where every maximal filler substring (of the form 'ogo' followed by any number of 'go' repetitions) is replaced by exactly three asterisks ('***'). Non-filler characters remain unchanged.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout[i] == '*' and stdout[i+1] == '*' and stdout[i+2] == '*') or (stdout[i] != '*' or stdout[i+1] != '*' or stdout[i+2] != '*') for i in range(len(stdout) - 2))
postconditions.description: Every occurrence of '***' in the output corresponds to a maximal filler substring in the input, and no other '*' characters appear outside these triplets.

postconditions.expression: all((s[i:i+3] == 'ogo' and all(s[i+3+k] == 'g' and s[i+4+k] == 'o' for k in range(0, m, 2))) == (stdout[i:i+3] == '***' and all(stdout[i+3+j] != '*' for j in range(1, m+1))) for i in range(len(s)) for m in range(0, len(s)-i, 2) if i+3+m <= len(s))
postconditions.description: For every possible maximal filler substring in s (starting with 'ogo' followed by any number of 'go' repetitions), the corresponding output substring is exactly '***', and no other '*' characters are introduced in the replacement.
